host: The machine that provides CPU, memory, storage and networking.
controller: The service that owns one project's queue, policy, API and dashboard.
worker: The execution process that runs isolated jobs on a host; not the host or an agent role.
harness: The program that runs an agent, such as Codex, Pi or a custom command.
agent: A configured work role with a responsibility and instructions, executed through a harness.
skill: Reusable instructions available to an agent or operator; not a process or an access grant.
workflow: The ordered agent steps, deterministic checks and approval gates for a work type.
task: A bounded work request admitted to the controller; stored as a job with retained run attempts.
automation: A trigger, filters and target that admits work automatically. Not yet implemented.
definition: The effective work roles, workflows, skills and installation settings, separate from runtime records.
